files.README.md:
# CSV Viewer

Open a local UTF-8 comma-separated CSV or load the bundled example. Search all fields and sort columns in both directions. Files stay in the app’s browser context without network upload. Quoted commas, escaped quotes and embedded line breaks are supported. Invalid quotes, inconsistent columns and files over 2 MB, 5,000 data rows or 100 columns show a recoverable error.

CSV Viewer

Open a CSV file to search and sort it. Your file stays in this app on your device.

Up to 2 MB, 5,000 rows and 100 columns. Comma-separated UTF-8 files.
